This name may resonate particularly with those living in regions that experience extensive rainfall, as the name symbolizes the joy and abundance that comes with a good rain. Additionally, in many Islamic cultures, the name may be given to a child born during a time of abundant rain or agricultural prosperity.

The name serves as a reminder that no matter the circumstances of our lives, there is always potential for growth and renewal, just as the earth is rejuvenated by rain. This name also encourages us to be grateful for the blessings in our lives and to appreciate the abundance that comes from God's provision.
